# Descriptive statistics

Table 1. Socio-demographic descriptive statistics.

```{r}
# table showing N and % by migration backgroundn, ECEC coverage (Low Medium High), Income (Low Medium High), Education Low Medium High, Age (4 cat), Parity (First brn vs subsequent), HH structure, working full time


CompareSamples <-MainDB %>%
  mutate(
    Control = ifelse(Assignment == "Control", 1, 0),
    SingleMum1or0 = ifelse(SingleMum == TRUE, 1, 0),
    Active1or0 = ifelse(Act3 == "Active", 1, 0),
    Educ1or0  = ifelse(Educ == "Sup", 1, 0),
    BornFr1or0  = ifelse(FrenchYNBaseline == "France", 1, 0),
    EverUsedECS1or0  = ifelse(UsedECEC == "Oui", 1, 0),
    PlanToUseECS1or0 = ifelse(ECSPlanToBaseline == TRUE, 1, 0),
    ComputerYes1or0 = ifelse(ComputerYN == "Oui", 1, 0),
    HighECSCov1or0 = ifelse(HighLowECECBaseline == "High ECEC covering", 1, 0), 
    DepParis1or0  = ifelse(Dep == "75", 1, 0),
    KnowsCrecheOnly1or0  = ifelse(KnowsCrecheOnly == TRUE, 1, 0),
    Primipare1or0 = ifelse(Primipare == TRUE, 1, 0), 
    WorkPlanTo1or0 = ifelse(WorkPlanTo == TRUE, 1, 0), 
    DeprivHolidays1or0 = ifelse(DeprivHolidays != "Pas du tout", 1, 0), NumberChildren = as.numeric(NumberChildren), 
    BabyFemale = ifelse(BabyFemale == TRUE, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(Educ2,
    "Single parent family" = SingleMum1or0,
    #  "Couple cohabiting" = CoupleCohabiting1or0,
    "Age of the mother" = Age,
    "Number of children" = NumberChildren,
    "Parity (first born vs subsequent)" = Primipare1or0,
    "Mother is born in France" = BornFr1or0,

    #  "The mothers is not born in MENAnorAsia" = BirthNotAsiaMENA1or0,
    "The mother is active at baseline" = Active1or0,
    "Household earns less than €2,500 per month" = FmilyEarnLessThan2500,
    #  "The family couldn't afford holidays" = DeprivHolidays1or0,
    #  "Has a computer" = ComputerYes1or0,
    "Mother is present oriented" = Discount501or0,
    "Mother wants to work after maternity leaves" = WorkPlanTo1or0,
    #"The mother did not smoke" = DidNotSmoke1or0,
    #"The mother wants to breastfeed" = BreastFeedIntend1or0, 
    "Household has ever used early childcare" = EverUsedECS1or0,                  # Used: yes/no/ don't wanna answer
   # "Household can access a computer" = ComputerYN,
    "Mother wants to use early childcare" = PlanToUseECS1or0,                 # Intend to use, block variable
    #  "Knows early childcare is subsidised" = AffordSubsidies1or0,
    #  "Knows only daycare" = KnowsCrecheOnly1or0,
    #    "Value socialization" = ValSocialisation,
    #"Believe in returns to early childcare" = LikertReturnHK1or0,
    #"The mother trusts early childcare" = TrustCreche1or0,
    "Mother lives in Paris" = DepParis1or0,
    "Early childcare coverage is high" = HighECSCov1or0,
    "Child is a girl" = BabyFemale
  )


# Create balance table using tbl_summary
summary_baseline_variables_endline <- CompareSamples %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = Educ2,  # Comparison by baseline and endline
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{p}% ({n})"
    ),
    digits = all_continuous() ~ 2,
    missing = "no"
  ) %>%
  add_overall() %>%
  add_p(pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 3)) %>% 
  add_q(method = "fdr", pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 3)) %>% 
  add_significance_stars(thresholds = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1)) %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**", stat_0 ~ "Overall", stat_1 ~ "High-SES", stat_2 ~ "Low-SES") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(c("stat_1", "stat_2") ~ "**Sample**")

# Convert to a flextable for formatting
summary_baseline_variables_endline %>%
  as_flex_table() %>%
  merge_v(part = "header", j = 1) %>%
  merge_h(part = "header", i = 1) %>%
  italic(j = 1, part = "body") |>  
  width(j = c(1), unit = "cm", width = 3) |>
  width(j = c(2:5), unit = "cm", width = 2) |>
  set_caption(caption = "Distribution of characteristics across high- and low-SES samples") %>%
  add_footer_lines(
    "Proportions and number of observations in parentheses for categorical and dichotomous variables. 
    Averages and standard deviations in parentheses for continuous variables. 
    Q-value control for the false discovery rate using FDR correction."
  ) %>%
  fontsize(i = 1, size = 10, part = "footer")


```

# The social stratification of intention, application and access

```{r}
library(fixest)
library(modelsummary)
cm <- c( '(Intercept)' = 'Constant', 'EducSup' = 'Level of Education of the mother: High-SES', "ECSApp"= "Applied")
lm1 <- feols(ECSPlanToBaseline~ Educ , data = MainDB, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)

lm2 <- feols(ECSApp~  Educ, data = Control, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)
lm5 <- feols(ECSApp~  Educ + ECSPlanToBaseline, data = Control, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)

lm3 <- feols(ECSUseYes~  Educ, data = Control, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)
lm4 <- feols(ECSUseYes~  Educ + ECSApp, data = Control, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)



modelsummary(list(
"Intention" = lm1,    
"Application" = lm2, 
"Application Intention" = lm5,
"Access" = lm3, 
"Access Apply" = lm4

), statistic = "{std.error} ({p.value})",
                      estimate="{estimate}{stars}  [{conf.low}, {conf.high}]",
                      gof_map = c("r.squared" ,"adj.r.squared" ,"nobs", "vcov.type", "FE"="FE: blocksMatWave" ),
                      stars = c("***"=.01,"**"=.05,"*"=.1),
                      title="Probability to be satisfied with the current childcare solution according to education level and ECEC used",
                      notes=list("",
                                 "Coefficient, 95 % CI in brackets, standard errors, p-value or adjusted p-value in parenthesis")
                      ,output = 'flextable',escape=TRUE, 
#coef_map = cm
)|>
  autofit()




```

## Introducing migration background

```{r}
library(fixest)
library(modelsummary)
cm <- c( '(Intercept)' = 'Constant', 'EducSup' = 'Level of Education of the mother: High-SES', "ECSApp"= "Applied")
lm1 <- feols(ECSPlanToBaseline~ Educ  + Migration4, data = MainDB, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)

lm2 <- feols(ECSApp~  Educ + Migration4 , data = Control, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)
lm5 <- feols(ECSApp~  Educ + ECSPlanToBaseline +  Migration4, data = Control, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)

lm3 <- feols(ECSUseYes~  Educ + Migration4 , data = Control, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)
lm4 <- feols(ECSUseYes~  Educ + ECSApp +  Migration4, data = Control, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)



modelsummary(list(
"Intention" = lm1,    
"Application" = lm2, 
"Application Intention" = lm5,
"Access" = lm3, 
"Access Apply" = lm4

), statistic = "{std.error} ({p.value})",
                      estimate="{estimate}{stars}  [{conf.low}, {conf.high}]",
                      gof_map = c("r.squared" ,"adj.r.squared" ,"nobs", "vcov.type", "FE"="FE: blocksMatWave" ),
                      stars = c("***"=.01,"**"=.05,"*"=.1),
                      title="Probability to be satisfied with the current childcare solution according to education level and ECEC used",
                      notes=list("",
                                 "Coefficient, 95 % CI in brackets, standard errors, p-value or adjusted p-value in parenthesis")
                      ,output = 'flextable',escape=TRUE, 
#coef_map = cm
)|>
  autofit()


```

## Machine learning

## Social stratification of these determinants

```{r}
library(fixest)
library(modelsummary)
cm <- c( '(Intercept)' = 'Constant', 'EducSup' = 'Level of Education of the mother: High-SES', "ECSApp"= "Applied")

lm1 <- feols(as.numeric(AccessInformalFullTime)~ Educ , data = DummiesSocioDemo, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)

lm2 <- feols(as.numeric(i(LevelInformation, ref = "Low knowledge"))~  Educ , data = DummiesSocioDemo, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)
lm3 <- feols(as.numeric(TrustEarlyChildcareAgree)~  Educ , data = DummiesSocioDemo, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)

lm4 <- feols(as.numeric(ECAccessHoursFit)~  Educ , data = DummiesSocioDemo, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)
lm5 <- feols(as.numeric(NegativeImpactSalary)~  Educ , data = DummiesSocioDemo, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)
lm6 <- feols(as.numeric(Active)~  Educ , data = DummiesSocioDemo, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)
lm7 <- feols(as.numeric(NormsScore)~  Educ  , data = DummiesSocioDemo, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)
lm8 <- feols(as.numeric(NegativeImpactWellBeing)~  Educ , data = DummiesSocioDemo, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)
lm9 <- feols(as.numeric(NegativeImpactCareer)~  Educ  , data = DummiesSocioDemo, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)
lm10 <- feols(as.numeric(NormsUseMostToAll)~  Educ  , data = DummiesSocioDemo, cluster = ~blocksMatWave)

modelsummary(list(
"Access to Informal Care" = lm1,    
"Level of Information" = lm2, 
"Trust in Early Childcare facilities" = lm3,
"Opening hours fit" = lm4, 
"Negative perceived impact on salary" = lm5,
"Active" = lm6,
"Adherence to traditional norms" = lm7,
"Negative perceived impact on well-being" = lm8,
"Negative perceived impact on career" = lm9,
"Norms: Use most to all" = lm10

), statistic = "{std.error} ({p.value})",
                      estimate="{estimate}{stars}  [{conf.low}, {conf.high}]",
                      gof_map = c("r.squared" ,"adj.r.squared" ,"nobs", "vcov.type", "FE"="FE: blocksMatWave" ),
                      stars = c("***"=.01,"**"=.05,"*"=.1),
                      title="Probability to be satisfied with the current childcare solution according to education level and ECEC used",
                      notes=list("",
                                 "Coefficient, 95 % CI in brackets, standard errors, p-value or adjusted p-value in parenthesis")
                      ,output = 'flextable',escape=TRUE,
#coef_map = cm
)|>
  autofit()


```
